test: raise line and branch coverage above 90% (#79)

* test: raise line and branch coverage above 90%

Cover WebSocket reconnect, TLS, ping, and proxy branches, plus core, date, retry, stream, and url edges that were keeping branch coverage near 83%.

* test: keep websocket coverage tests compatible with Node 12 and 14

Replace fs.rmSync and the global AbortController, which those CI versions do not provide.

* test: tolerate early timer firing in sleep assertion

A 10ms sleep can return in under 10ms on CI, so the strict lower bound was
